decisions.reason: The ceiling or floor pipe bracket builds directly on the core pipeline component range and was publicly committed to with its own page, so management will keep supporting it as part of the announced range expansion.

Although distant from the core, the powder-coated public waste bin makes use of the firm's coating equipment investment and serves the same municipal customers, so weak results can still be put down to slow public procurement cycles.
As a multi-model line with its own page, the waste bin with ashtray represents a visible investment that management will want to justify, and it fits municipal tendering for street furniture.

The outdoor ashtray line is the most peripheral of the products and faces declining smoking rates, but the sunk investment in several models and the shared coating capability lead management to persist for now.
